name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-08-30, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
